name: Francesco Giardini
bio: A Ferrara privateer who drove Maserati A6GCS/53 chassis 2089 to fourth overall in the 1955 Mille Miglia and won the two-litre Sport class with it — the leading finish by anyone outside a works team, behind only the two Mercedes 300 SLRs and Maglioli's Ferrari. The same chassis also ran at Le Mans, Monza and the Targa Florio in period.
